Definition: from G430 and G2556; enduring of ill, i.e. forbearing:--patient.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells Timothy the servant of the Lord must be patient, enduring evil without striking back, apt to teach and gentle to all. The word is the patience that absorbs a wrong and does not return it.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for patient endurance carries no system of its own; its standard is Paul's, that the Lord's servant answers evil with teaching, not with temper.
